name: scavenger
theme: a sun-baked desert junk lot of rusted cars and broken concrete
description: A gaunt wasteland scavenger in layered sun-bleached cotton rags under a hooded dust cloak of patched sackcloth, brass welding goggles pushed up on the hood, a frayed khaki scarf over the mouth, fingerless leather gloves, a frame backpack strapped tight to the back and stuffed with scrap metal, coiled copper wire and a dented jerrycan, holding a long iron crowbar in the right hand
